# Vocabulary.com

> > An interactive English dictionary and vocabulary learning platform that helps students and educators build word knowledge through definitions, examples, and engaging word games.

Vocabulary.com combines a comprehensive English dictionary with adaptive learning tools, competitive word games like Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam, and classroom resources for teachers to enhance student vocabulary acquisition and engagement.

- Vocabulary.com
- English Dictionary
